title: Member Benefits Schedule: Wayfare Pass Goodwill on Cleaning and Damage Fees Cleaning Charges
content:
**Rule.** The Pass goodwill of a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee approved at review is read from the rider's Wayfare Pass membership in active status: Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual and Wayfare Pass All Access Annual take the Plus-tier goodwill; Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Annual and Wayfare Pass Student take the base-tier goodwill; a rider with no active membership takes no Pass goodwill.

| Rider's Wayfare Pass (rider membership) plan, in active status | Pass goodwill |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | $20.00 (Plus tier) |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | $20.00 (Plus tier) |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | $20.00 (Plus tier) |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | $10.00 (base tier) |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | $10.00 (base tier) |
| Wayfare Pass Student | $10.00 (base tier) |
| no membership in active status | none |

The Pass goodwill is a fixed amount subtracted from the fee once the fee has been held to its ceiling.

**Questions on the schedule**

*Does a membership that is paused, past due, in trial or cancelled count?* No. Only a membership whose status is active counts; a rider whose membership is in any other status has no active membership and takes no Pass goodwill.

*Where is the plan read?* From the rider's membership record in Wayfare Pass (rider membership): the plan name and the status.
